browser_queue.label: Find-a-Grave -- HOWARD EDDIE death record

browser_queue.instructions: Click any hit, MHTML the obit. Tells us: death date, age, surviving family names + cities (= heir candidates).

browser_queue.label: Facebook public search -- HOWARD EDDIE in SAN ANTONIO
browser_queue.instructions: If profile public, tells us age range, employer, family, recent posts. Don't friend; just look. MHTML the search result page.

browser_queue.label: LinkedIn search -- HOWARD EDDIE SAN ANTONIO
browser_queue.instructions: Profession, employer, tenure. Helps frame the pitch (busy professional = lead with time-saving; recent retiree = lead with simplicity).

browser_queue.label: County assessor for SAN ANTONIO TX -- check if owner has property there too

browser_queue.instructions: Search 'HOWARD EDDIE'. Civil suits, eviction filings, foreclosure starts = financial pressure signals.

browser_queue.label: Newspaper archive: Daily Memphian search -- 'HOWARD EDDIE'

pitch_hooks.name: estate_burden_relief
pitch_hooks.angle: Empathy for the estate process + we close direct with executor
pitch_hooks.lead_line: I understand the family may still be settling the estate, and out-of-state real estate paperwork can drag on. We close direct with the executor in 14 days — no agent, no inspection, no out-of-pocket cost to the estate.
pitch_hooks.use_when: Always lead with this if estate is open in probate.

pitch_hooks.name: outofstate_convenience
pitch_hooks.angle: Distance is the pain; we handle 100% remotely
pitch_hooks.lead_line: Managing a Memphis property from San Antonio TX is its own kind of work — tax notices, code letters, occasional weed-cutting bills. We handle the full close-out by mail and wire. You don't fly in.

pitch_hooks.name: long_ownership_dignified_close
pitch_hooks.lead_line: You've held this property for 21 years — that's a long time. Memphis values have shifted and so has the cost of carrying property. We can offer a clean, no-surprise close.
pitch_hooks.use_when: Owner held property >=20 years, no estate.

pitch_hooks.name: back_tax_relief
pitch_hooks.angle: We pay the back tax — you walk clean
pitch_hooks.lead_line: We see the property's been on the back-tax list for a few years. We pay every dollar of back tax + penalty at closing — out of OUR side, not yours. You walk away clean.
pitch_hooks.use_when: TS2202 lead. Strong on absentee owners with no plan to develop.

pitch_hooks.name: vacant_lot_quick_cash
pitch_hooks.angle: Lots are inert assets; we move fast
pitch_hooks.lead_line: Vacant lots aren't easy to sell — agents don't want them, builders take months. We'll wire cash for 117  FARROW AVE in 14 days. No fix-up. No inspection. As-is.
